threads.body: Removing `http.route` leaves this snapshot's findings naming `GET /health`, `GET /status/*`, `GET /users/*`, and `POST /items`, although the new policy produces method-only names. The finding messages and `signal_name` values must change, and the identical GET findings collapse; otherwise the scenario freshness check will fail. Regenerate the complete snapshot on Linux; the same issue affects `scenarios/http/go/go-restful/obi/server/data.json:155–187`.

replies.body: Fixed in afe75a42 using the snapshots generated by the Linux CI run. Echo and go-restful now record method-only names in their findings, with duplicate GET findings collapsed. The CI output also restores the `http.route` metric attribute keys that OBI still emits.

threads.body: Setting outgoing unmatched routes to `unset` removes `url.template` and makes span names method-only for the net/http OBI client, which supplies concrete URLs rather than route templates. However, `scenarios/http/go/net-http/obi/client/data.json` still records `url.template` and route-based names in its findings, leaving the baseline stale and causing the scenario freshness check to fail. Regenerate and commit that client snapshot with the new configuration on Linux as well.

threads.body: For Tomcat (and Grizzly), `/users/*` and `/status/*` are the actual servlet/handler mappings, so the heuristic route was correct here. Fine to drop it for a uniform config, but the comment shouldn't call it undiscoverable.

@@ -1,12 +1,9 @@
 # Copyright The OpenTelemetry Authors
 # SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
 
-# OBI does not get the route templates for Tomcat, so it falls back to a route
-# derived from the request path (`/users/*`, `/status/*`) and uses it for
-# `http.route` and the span name. Semconv says `http.route` must not be
-# populated in that case and the span name should be just the method; OBI does
-# that with `routes.unmatched: unset`. This baseline records OBI's default,
-# `heuristic`.
+# OBI cannot discover this server's route templates. The shared OBI
+# configuration leaves unknown routes unset, so `http.route` is omitted
+# and the server span name is just the HTTP method.

threads.body: Client side changes too: `url.template` is gone and span names collapse to `GET`/`POST`. Worth a mention in the docs or this scenario's `conformance.yaml`?

Metrics still carry `http.route`, so maybe something more precise (same for the Go/Java READMEs):

```suggestion
The shared OBI configuration sets `unmatched: unset` for incoming and outgoing
routes, so spans omit `http.route` and `url.template` when OBI doesn't know the
route. Server metrics still carry `http.route`.
```
